compound attributing the causing of fear to the subject

items.question: What constant afflictions and harmful influences define this figure's nature?
premises: She is afflicted by hunger and thirst.
This affliction persists at all times.
She serves as an abode for quarrel.
items.inference: Her nature combines perpetual deprivation with the instigation of fear and conflict.
items.plain_english: Always tormented by hunger and thirst, she inspires fear and is an abode of quarrel.
